name: @promptguard/mcp-server
stderr:
PromptGuard CLI not found.

  The MCP server is built into the PromptGuard CLI. Install it:

    macOS:   brew install promptguard/tap/promptguard
    Linux:   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acebot712/promptguard-cli/main/install.sh | sh
    Cargo:   cargo install promptguard

  Then run again:
    npx @promptguard/mcp-server

  Docs: https://docs.promptguard.co/tools/mcp
